method: Read-only source/call-path/diff inspection. This receipt binds the stable reviewed-area source snapshots below; it is not a whole-repository or whole-file audit.

findings.conclusion: No concrete new bounds, lifetime, or false-success defect found within the stated reviewed paths.

checked_properties: Loader override bounds remain intact and pointer-range overflow is checked; ordinary process-limit subtraction and alignment clamp instead of unsigned wrap.
Allocator capacity, aggregate available estimate, and kernel process accounting remain distinct; telemetry explicitly disclaims largest contiguous free knowledge.
Device DEX admission uses actual owned raw capacity and conservative decoded table/string charges; cumulative policy rejection precedes decoded parsing.
Execution frame leave uses exact owner plus serial ticket; scope restore uses the captured owner, so independent native-suspended owners do not remove each others roots.
The device identity provider uses the actual nonzero platform thread handle; the collector traces every active owner and completed owner metadata is pruned.
Encoding bounds names before fixed-buffer lookup, checks encoded size and actual Value backing charge before reserve, and fills the final vector without intervening VM callbacks/GC.
Unknown/null names, known missing encoders, managed-budget denial and backing-reserve failure preserve distinct real error contracts; no unsupported conversion reports success.
limits: Admission estimates and managed Heap budgets do not form a hard process RSS guarantee.

Preexisting Heap arena metadata, interpreter register buffers, classpath method/code/descriptor caches and some parser vectors still grow through infallible allocations; host allocation exhaustion can abort despite lower logical/managed usage.
Aggregate newlib free space is not the largest contiguous block; fragmentation can fail a reservation below the reported aggregate.
The owner review relies on the documented exclusive VM lease, real per-thread identity and same-thread native-call return contract; it does not establish arbitrary backend correctness.
Encoding retains the documented unpaired UTF16-surrogate representation limitation and explicit unsupported encoder/provider/option gaps.
This is not a full security review, adversarial memory-exhaustion execution, new test result, or complete external-APK compatibility proof.

stable_reviewed_area_snapshots.reviewed_area: heap plan subtraction/alignment/clamping; loader-override precedence; aggregate-free calculation
libnx heap initialization, override address bounds, allocator snapshots, truthful noncontiguous telemetry, application-override admission
raw capacity, decoded string/table/map/class-index charges, bounded input access, cumulative budget rejection before metadata decode
string table bounds, one-MiB encoded-string scan bound and actual decoded allocation strategy used by admission accounting
lossy decoder output expansion and String capacity strategy relevant to the DEX estimate
parser/raw policy ceilings, actual-free callback reserve guard and reporting scope
real Value-array charge, owner identity binding, per-owner allocation pins/cutoffs, captured-owner scope restore and preexisting arena growth
stable owner/serial frame tickets, owner-specific root publication and diagnostics, independent scope restoration, active-owner bound and completed-owner pruning
root union across suspended owners and native/framework graphs, current-owner root updates and free-slot filtering
actual native thread identity contract and shared identity provider binding into Heap
fixed-size charset-name buffers, checked output length/Value charge, fallible final vector reserve, signed byte output and explicit error/gap handling
explicit encoder-alias versus known-unsupported recognition data boundaries
getBytes overload routing before legacy source-string cloning
